title: Environment Variables
desc: Configurable environment variables resolved in app config.
lede: Studio reads a handful of environment variables for storage roots, plugin locations, and behavior.
body:
At a glance
  • Storage roots and base directory.
  • Plugin and plugin-data locations.
  • Engine env, ports, and test-mode flags.

Common variables

VariablePurpose
AUDIOBOOK_BASE_DIRBase directory for storage roots.
PLUGINS_DIR / PLUGIN_DATA_DIRWhere engines and their data live.
XTTS_ENV_DIRLocation of the engine environment.
TTS_API_PRIORITYGateway vs Studio scheduling mode.
Note — Ports and test-mode flags are also configurable; see the app config for the full list.
